notes.off: A note above the Themes page: labeling is switched off. One form per kind of label: intent (what a person wanted: asking, writing…) and themes (topics). <link> wraps the name of the Settings page and links to it; the sentence ends there, with no period.
notes.unevaluated: A note above the Themes page: labeling is on, but the model's labels only count once its version passes an evaluation against admins' labels. One form per kind of label. <link> wraps the name of the Settings page and links to it; no period at the end.
totals.sessions: Each totals.*: a stat tile. Sessions (stretches of one chat) people had with socios (AI agents).
totals.with-intent: The share of sessions with an intent (what the person wanted).
totals.with-themes: The share of sessions with themes (topics).
intents.title: Heading of the card of sessions by intent (what people wanted: asking, writing, analyzing…).
intents.description: "Turn": one answer from a socio (an AI agent).
intents.empty: In place of the intents card's table when the range has no sessions.
themes.title: Heading of the card of themes (groups of topics the model named for sessions), and its table's accessible name.
themes.description: {{count}} is how many different people a theme needs before it is named (a privacy floor). "The hint": the model's guess whether the person's need was resolved.
themes.chart: Accessible name of the menu that picks which theme the chart shows.
themes.chart-all: Heading of the chart of all sessions with themes, per week; also its name for screen readers.
themes.chart-topic: Heading of the chart of one theme's sessions, per week. {{topic}} is the theme's words, as the model named them; keep the quotation marks of your language.
themes.series-topic: The same chart's name for screen readers. {{topic}} is the theme's words.
themes.axis: The chart's value in its accessible description ("Bar chart of sessions by week…"); lowercase.
themes.every: The menu's choice that charts every theme together.
themes.empty: In place of the themes table when no session in the range has themes.
themes.no-answer: In place of the themes when the analytics store returned nothing.
hidden.themes: Under the table: themes not named because fewer than {{min}} people had them (a privacy floor). {{count}} is how many.
hidden.more: Under the table: themes left out past the first {{shown}} listed. {{count}} is how many.
hidden.sessions: Under the table: sessions that fall on none of the themes listed.
table.mostly: Column heading: the intent most of the theme's sessions had (what people wanted).
table.hint: Column heading: the model's guess whether people's needs were resolved.
table.unresolved: In the Hint column: {{share}} is the percentage of the theme's sessions the model thinks went unresolved.
outcome.resolved: Each outcome.*: the model's guess whether a session's need was resolved; a choice in the outcome hint menu.
outcome.unresolved: The model's guess: the person's need seems not resolved.
outcome.unclear: The model's guess: it can't tell whether the person's need was resolved.
outcome-inline.resolved: Each outcome-inline.*: the same as outcome.*, lowercase, inside a sentence (label.model-topics).
outcome-inline.unresolved: Lowercase, inside a sentence; the same as outcome.unresolved.
outcome-inline.unclear: Lowercase, inside a sentence; the same as outcome.unclear.
sure: On a session in the review list: how confident the model is in its label. {{confidence}} is a percentage.
review.title: Heading of the card where admins review the model's labels on sessions.
review.description: "Golden set": the admin-made labels the model's answers are scored against. The access log records each time an admin reads a person's content.
review.labels: Accessible name of the menu that picks which kind of label to review.
review.intent: A choice in that menu: intent labels (what the person wanted).
review.themes: A choice in that menu: theme labels (topics).
review.which: Accessible name of the menu that picks which sessions to list.
review.unreviewed: A choice in the menu of which sessions to review: those no admin has labeled yet.
review.all: A choice in the menu of which sessions to review: every session that has a label.
review.list: Accessible name of the list of sessions to review.
review.empty-unreviewed: In place of the Review card's list on the Themes page when Not reviewed yet is picked and no session waits for an admin's review.
review.empty: In place of the Review card's list when Every labeled session is picked and the model hasn't labeled any session yet.
review.no-topics: In place of a session's topics when it has none.
review.reviewed: Badge on a session an admin labeled.
label.title: Accessible name of an opened session's panel of labels.
label.load-failed: Shown when the session's labels didn't load and the server gave no reason.
label.saved: Toast after an admin saved a session's label. "Themes" is the name of the dashboard page.
label.save-failed: Shown when saving failed and the server gave no reason.
label.by-model: Who set the label in force, for label.in-force's {{by}}: the model. {{when}} is a date and time.
label.by-admin: The same, for an admin: {{name}} is the admin's name, {{when}} a date and time.
label.by-unknown: The same, for an admin whose name is gone. {{when}} is a date and time.
label.input: Label over the text the model read: the chat's title and first messages, with contact details and secrets removed.
label.untitled: In place of a chat's title when it has none.
label.intent: Subheading of the intent part (what the person wanted), and the accessible name of its menu.
label.model-intent: The model's suggested intent: {{intent}} is its name (data, such as Write), {{confidence}} a percentage. The _applied form: the label is in force. <strong> emphasizes the intent.
label.in-force: The label in force: {{value}} is the intent's name or the topics, {{by}} one of label.by-*.
label.save-intent: Button that saves the chosen intent.
label.model-topics: The model's suggested topics: {{topics}} is a list of topic words (data), {{outcome}} one of outcome-inline.*, {{confidence}} a percentage. The _applied form: the label is in force. <strong> emphasizes the topics.
label.topic: Accessible name of a topic field: {{n}} is its position (1, 2, 3).
label.main-topic: Placeholder of the first topic field.
label.another-topic: Placeholder of the second and third topic fields.
label.outcome-hint: Accessible name of the menu that sets whether the session's need seems resolved.
label.save-topics: Button that saves the topics and outcome hint.
label.topics-hint: Beside the Save topics button: how to write topics.
